cards.name: Discoid eczema / nummular
cards.clue: Coin plaques, less violaceous polygonal papules

items.t: Non-healing oral ulcer, white patch that thickens or a lump in long-standing oral LP: **refer urgently** (oral SCC).
Genital erosions, scarring or dyspareunia: refer (vulval or penile LP).
Scalp redness with scarring hair loss: lichen planopilaris, early referral.

pearls.t: Warn about post-inflammatory pigment lasting months.
Advise against vigorous scrubbing of Wickham-striae scale.
Sexual health / genital itch: examine and refer early if erosive.
Document HCV risk discussion where relevant.
